content: Headless Vulkan CI without real GPU hardware commonly uses Google SwiftShader (CPU Vulkan implementation) or Mesa Lavapipe/LLVMpipe (Vallium) as a software rasterizer fallback so tests still run on GPU-less CI runners; a published GitHub Action exists to install Vulkan SDK + SwiftShader/Lavapipe. Separately, glslc/glslang/SPIRV-Tools (spirv-val) run standalone with no GPU/driver at all, so shader-compile and SPIR-V-validation stages can be exercised on any CI runner even when real end-to-end GPU execution is out of scope.
